msa_policy: Explicit sequence-only for every new run: no homolog MSA loaded. Query-only features are frozen per context and shared across both checkpoints and backends. Previously saved full20/100 MSA runs are separately labelled historical controls.
profile_policy: Fast documented example3loops/50requestedsteps; matched Full3/50 sequence-only control; Full20/100 sequence-only control against saved full20/100 with cached SUMO MSA. One fresh process per context/backend/profile, two same-seed calls in each (first and resident timing reported separately). No pooled fresh/resident mean.
acceptance: Exact sequences and complete backbone for all chains
Audited per-unit outputs and immutable receipts
Native GPU learned inference with explicit counted tiny CPU SVD
Retain geometry/confidence flags, never filter poor predictions
analysis: Monomer exact-sequence crystal3QHT core21-96; complex pose agreement versus saved full and Boltz/Protenix, common ipSAE, geometry. No experimental complex reference; confidence/agreement is not binding validation.

checkpoint_policy: Last unbundled official Fast checkpoint matches pinned reference runtime. New September bundled Transformers export not tested. Native head config and sampler coefficients retained.
